Headline: Share Your Agentic Wallet Experience for Rewards
Prize pool: 5,000 USDT
Start: 2026-11-23T08:15:00Z · End: 2026-12-03T08:15:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 100 USDT
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Wallet is excited to announce a new campaign for the Binance Agentic Wallet users. Share your experience using Agentic Wallet for Prediction Markets on X and get a chance to share 5,000 USDT in rewards!
Promotion Period: 2026-11-23 08:15 (UTC) to 2026-12-03 08:15 (UTC)
## How to Participate
Step 1: Quote this campaign post on your X (formerly Twitter) account and share your ideas, strategies or experience using Agentic Wallet for Prediction Markets.
Step 2: Submit your post link and account information via the survey.
Note: You must complete at least 1 Prediction Market trade with Agentic Wallet before posting to be eligible for this Promotion.
## Eligibility
Only Binance Wallet users who maintain an active verified Binance account are eligible to participate in this Promotion.
This campaign is not open to residents or citizens of the United States, the United Kingdom, the European Economic Area (all 30 member states), Hong Kong, Singapore, or any other jurisdiction on Binance's List of Prohibited Countries. For the avoidance of doubt, any content, posts, entries, or submissions made by users from these jurisdictions, however submitted or tagged, will not be counted, considered, or eligible for any reward, recognition, or prize.
Only users who have used Agentic Wallet for Prediction Markets under the “Up/Down”, “Sports” or “Esports” categories are eligible (past usage also counts).
If you do not have an Agentic Wallet, please refer to How to Create an Agentic Wallet; and to learn more, please refer to the Prediction Market page.
## Rewards
Sharing Prize Pool (4,000 USDT): Based on the order of survey submission, the rewards will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis. The first 800 eligible users whose entries pass the content review will equally share 4,000 USDT, i.e., 5 USDT each. If there are fewer than 800 eligible users, all eligible users will equally share 4,000 USDT, with each user’s reward kept to 2 decimal places and truncated (not rounded). For example, if there are 600 eligible users, each will receive 4,000 / 600 = 6.666…, which is 6.66 USDT.
Outstanding Sharer Reward (1,000 USDT): 10 outstanding posts will be selected by Binance Wallet team in its sole discretion based on content quality, usefulness and creativity. Each eligible winner will receive 100 USDT. Winners will be announced after the Promotion Period ends.
## Reward Distribution
All rewards will be distributed in USDT to eligible users’ Spot Account within 14 business days after the Promotion Period ends.
Rewards will be sent to the Binance account associated with the winning user’s UID.
## Notes
Each user may participate only once. Posts must be original and remain public until rewards are distributed.
All entries will be reviewed for authenticity and content quality. Entries that are low-quality, irrelevant to Agentic Wallet, mass-produced with AI, plagiarized or spam will be disqualified and will not be eligible for rewards. Binance Wallet’s review decision is final.
Binance Wallet reserves the right to disqualify any participant involved in any fraudulent activity and has the right of final decision regarding this Promotion.
## Terms & Conditions
Only users who maintain an active Binance account are eligible to participate in this Promotion.
This Promotion is not sponsored, endorsed, or administered by X (formerly Twitter) or any other social media platforms.
## Reward Distribution:
Each user is only permitted one account. If anyone is found in breach of Binance Wallet Terms including the rules under multiple account usage, they will be deemed in violation upon verification and disqualified.
Users may interact with Third-Party Services and DApps through this Promotion. Third-Party Service Providers operate independently and may have different security standards, operational practices, and regulatory compliance. Binance Wallet does not control or guarantee the performance, security, or reliability of these Third-Parties. Users are responsible to conduct their own independent research to ensure the Third-Party Service is suitable for them.
Disclaimer: Prediction Markets are not provided by Binance’s ADGM entities and can only be accessed if you hold a Binance Wallet. The Binance Wallet Services are provided by Binance Barbados Limited. The Binance Wallet Services are not under the supervision of the Financial Services Regulatory Authority or any other regulatory authority. Binance Wallet does not sponsor, endorse, or guarantee such third-party services. Binance does not act as the counterparty in any investments in the Prediction Markets feature. Investment using the Prediction Markets feature comes with significant risk, including financial risk, market volatility, regulatory risk, third-party risks. You may lose part or all of what you have invested through the Prediction Markets feature. For more information, please see our Risk Warning and Terms of Use.

Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: New Users Exclusive: Subscribe to USDT Simple Earn Flexible Products to Enjoy 35% Bonus APR!
Start: 2026-11-23T12:00:00Z · End: 2027-01-31T23:59:00Z
Smallest threshold (parsed): 200 USDT (stake)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance is excited to announce this week’s Binance Starter Carnival promotion on Simple Earn Flexible Products for all eligible new users*! Eligible new users who complete any amount of deposit can get an exclusive 35% Bonus Tiered APR rewards for 7 days on USDT Flexible Products on top of Real-Time APR rewards.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-23 12:00:00 (UTC) to 2027-01-31 23:59:59 (UTC)
*Eligible new users refers to users who are newly registered on the Binance platform after 2026-11-23 12:00:00 (UTC) and have passed identity verification.
Note: The campaign and the products mentioned may not be available in your jurisdiction. Users may check USDT Flexible Products page to see offer details.
## Reward Structure
Rewards are distributed per the table below. The below table shows progressive tiers. The bonus APR is calculated cumulatively, rather than applying a single rate to eligible users’ entire subscription amount.
Digital Asset | Duration | APR During the Promotion Period | Minimum Subscription Limit per User | Maximum Subscription Limit per User
USDT | 7 days | Tier Range: Subscription Amount ≤ 200 USDT | Tier Range: Subscription Amount > 200 USDT | 0.1 USDT | Unlimited
Real-Time APR + 35% Bonus Tiered APR (0 - 200 USDT) | Real-Time APR
Subscribe Now
## Please Note
It may take up to 5 to 10 minutes before eligible users can see and subscribe to the promotion on the USDT Flexible Products page.
Subscription Format: Maximum seven (7) days of subscription period. Complete subscription on a first-come, first-served basis in accordance with the terms above.
The 7-day offer starts from the day that eligible users subscribe to USDT Flexible Products.
## APR Rewards Distribution:
Bonus Tiered APR: Distributed to users’ Spot Accounts on a daily basis. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription).
Real-Time APR: Accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
The special Bonus Tiered APR reward is only effective for 7 days from the subscription date and is only applicable to the user’s first 200 USDT subscribed to USDT Flexible Products during the Promotion Period. Any subscription amount exceeding 200 USDT will only earn Real-Time APR rewards.
Eligible users can still receive the Bonus APR reward once they subscribe to USDT Flexible Products during the Promotion Period, even if the remaining 7-day period extends beyond the Promotion Period.
## How to Get Started with USDT Flexible Products
Step 1. Newly-registered, verified users can add funds through any of the following channels to be eligible for the USDT special offer:
Crypto Deposit: Complete your first deposit via Crypto Deposit with a minimum amount of $1 equivalent.
P2P Buy: Complete your first crypto purchase via P2P Buy with a minimum amount of $1 equivalent.
Fiat Deposit/Buy Crypto: Complete your first deposit via Fiat Deposit or your first crypto purchase via Buy Crypto with a minimum amount of $1 equivalent.
Note: Purchases made via Fiat balance in your Binance account will not be considered as an eligible action.
Step 2. Go to [Simple Earn], and search for USDT.
Step 3. Select “Flexible”, and subscribe to USDT Simple Earn Flexible Products to start earning exclusive APR rewards!
## Terms & Conditions
Only users who complete identity verification during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotion, and only master accounts qualify for rewards in the Promotion. Sub-accounts are not eligible to receive rewards.
The products or features referred to above may not be available in your region. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Changes to the Binance Simple Earn Rewards Rate will be published on the Platform from time to time. Please refer to Binance Simple Earn Terms & Conditions and Risk Warning for more information prior to using Binance Simple Earn.
## Rewards:
Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for accurate information. Real-Time APR rewards are accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute.
Bonus Tiered APR is offered as an additional reward on top of Real-Time APR. Upon subscription, Bonus Tiered APR rewards start to accrue the next day starting from 00:00 (UTC) based on the snapshot of your subscribed amounts to the Flexible Product of the day, which will be taken randomly between 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 (UTC) daily. Rewards will start to be distributed the following day after accrual starts between 00:00 (UTC) and 08:00 (UTC) to the user’s Spot Account.
Any redemption of Flexible Products between 00:00:00 (UTC) and 00:00:00 (UTC) of the following day will stop the accrual of Bonus Tiered APR rewards on the redeemed amount for that day.
Redemptions of Flexible Products will be processed starting with assets that have accrued rewards. Users can check the rewards history from the Earn History.
Bonus Tiered APR rewards are calculated based on the subscribed amounts and are subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to the FAQ for more details.
Eligible users who subscribe to USDT Simple Earn Flexible Products promotion will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards for up to 7 days for USDT during the Promotion Period. Before the Promotion ends, users can enjoy the Bonus APR rate within the 7-day period after the first subscription. Redemption within the 7-day period will terminate the reward accrual of the Bonus Tiered APR rewards from the redemption day. After the Promotion ends, users will only be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards.
Example: New User A subscribes to USDT Flexible Products on 2026-11-26, redeems on 2026-11-29, and resubscribes on 2026-11-30. Bonus Tiered APR rewards will accrue on 2026-11-27, 2026-11-28, and 2026-11-31, and be distributed to User A on 2026-11-28, 2026-11-29, and 2026-12-01. Bonus Tiered APR rewards are calculated based on the subscribed amounts and are subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to the FAQ for more details.
APR rewards are distributed from Binance’s own funds, and are determined based on the assessment and evaluation of prevailing market conditions. This Promotion is not associated with the issuer of USDT in any manner.
The Promotion's subscription amount of each user has an upper limit. When the upper limit is reached, users will no longer be able to subscribe.
A large amount of redemption requests might delay redemption temporarily. Redemptions may resume upon return of liquidity.
Users can view their Flexible Products assets by going to Assets > Earn > Simple Earn.
Redemption time for Flexible Products subscriptions: Instant.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
